title: Raising Awareness amongst Parents on Youth Mental Health
what_it_is: Raising Awareness amongst Parents on Youth Mental Health

sections.label: Youth mental health promotion
sections.summary: Ministries, agencies and community partners work to promote youth mental health, and HPB runs mental health education for parents of pre-school and Primary school children.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Youth mental health and well-being is an important issue, and there has been a concerted effort between Ministries, agencies and community partners to promote and support youth mental health awareness, including amongst parents.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Health Promotion Board or HPB conducts mental health education programmes for parents with pre-school and Primary school-going children, to equip them with the knowledge and skills to develop and strengthen their children’s mental well-being, social and emotional intelligence, and resilience.

sections.label: Expert videos on teen issues
sections.summary: Experts Dr Daniel Fung and Mr Arthur Ling spoke on teen behavioural issues, parenting and family relationships, and the videos have about 2.5 million views.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Experts such as Dr Daniel Fung, Chief Executive Officer of the Institute of Mental Health (IMH), and Mr Arthur Ling, Deputy Executive Director of Fei Yue Community Services, were invited to speak on teen behavioural issues, parenting as well as building strong family relationships.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: These videos have been well-received, with about 2.5 million views to-date.

sections.label: Community Psychology Hub counselling
sections.summary: In 2020, over 1,200 clients were supported through the Community Psychology Hub online counselling service.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In 2020, over 1,200 clients have been supported through the Community Psychology Hub online counselling service.

sections.label: Parenting programme outcomes
sections.summary: Parents reported less parenting stress, improved emotional states and reduced child behavioural problems, with about 20% reductions three months after completing the programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: They have also experienced less parenting stress, improved emotional states that they experience and also reduced behavioural problems that they find in their children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: So, overall, on a more sustained basis, more specifically, parents have also come back to tell us that about 20% reduction in both their children's problematic behavioural scores have been observed, as well as their own parenting stress scores.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And this is taken about three months after they have completed the programme.

sections.label: Working with community partners
sections.summary: The speaker says they will work with community partners to proliferate this programme, which is good for all parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: As much as possible, we will definitely work with community partners to try to proliferate and make this programme, which is a good programme for all parents, myself included.
